about_the_game:
The first mainline Streets of Rage game in more than 25 years, Streets of Rage 4 reunites the series’ original brawling trio for an all-new experience backed by a gorgeous hand-drawn art style invoking the series’ gritty urban aesthetic.

To continue the legacy around this series’ music, SOR 4 OST roster features original composers Yūzō Koshiro & Motohiro Kawashima, alongside guest musicians Yoko Shimomura, Harumi Fujita, Keiji Yamagishi, Scattle, Das Mörtal, XL Middleton, Groundislava and Olivier Deriviere as main composer. Plus Tee Lopes for the Mr. X Nightmare DLC.
